_comment: D124. The first holocall in this quest. Mara rings V once the ending has
resolved and makes good on the last thing she said out loud in D123:
'Keep the phone on. One day you'll want the address.' She gives the address.
WHY THIS IS A SCENE AND NOT A MESSAGE: the phone UI is opened by the quest
graph, not by anything in here - questCallContact_NodeType, wired either side
of this scene in quest_graph.json. The engine ships NO scene-side phone event
at all (`strings` on Cyberpunk2077.exe matches nothing for
^scn.*(Phone|Call|Holo).*$), so the division is fixed: the graph opens and
closes the call, the scene is only the conversation that happens inside it.
WHY NOBODY SPAWNS: scene.holocall makes every non-player actor a VOICE -
acquisitionPlan findInContext with contextualName 'Voice', field for field
with q005_07's penthouse Siri. There is no entity, so there is nothing to
place, and unlike D123 there is not even a doorway to stand in. It also means
the keepAlive question that hangs over scene_aftertalk.json cannot arise here:
a voice actor is not spawned, so a Mara left standing in the clinic is
irrelevant to it.
WHY NO set_tier: a phone call is not a conversation you stand still for.
q112_03_infiltration brackets two Takemura calls and contains exactly one tier
node in the whole phase, Tier1_FullGameplay. So V keeps walking, and the one
thing to watch in game is whether the choice hub below still draws while they
do - every other hub in this quest has had Tier3 under it.
The hub does not branch. Both options reach the same answer, for the same
reason scene_aftertalk.json's does: this is the player's one chance to react,
not a second decision twenty seconds after the real one. What differs is only
whether V asks her about herself or about the job.
Deliberately ONE version, no warm/cold split. She is not calling as a friend
on either route - she is closing a file and squaring a debt with somebody she
will never speak to again, which is exactly as true after the intimidate route
as after the others. D121's route_verdict already gives the cold path its own
SMS; giving it its own call as well would be splitting a beat that has the
same meaning both ways.

lines.en-us: Don't say my name. This line is clean for about ninety seconds and then it's a number in somebody's log.
lines.ua-ua: Не називай мого імені. Ця лінія чиста секунд дев'яносто, а потім стане номером у чиємусь лозі.

lines.en-us: I'm out of the city. No plates, no chip, took the long way. You won't hear this number again.
lines.ua-ua: Я вже за містом. Без номерів, без чипа, їхала в об'їзд. Цього номера ти більше не почуєш.

lines.en-us: Because I said you'd want the address, and I don't like owing people. So here it is, and then we're square.
lines.ua-ua: Бо я сказала, що ти попросиш адресу, а я не люблю бути винною. Тож ось вона — і ми квити.

lines.en-us: Cynosure. The dig runs under the Badlands, north-west of the solar farm. Militech sank it, the FIA kept the lights on.
lines.ua-ua: Сайносур. Шахта тягнеться під Пустищем, на північний захід від сонячної ферми. «Мілітех» її пробив, ФІА лишило світло ввімкненим.

lines.en-us: Whatever your splinter was cut from is still on a rack down there. Still running. Nobody ever turned it off, they just stopped writing it down.
lines.ua-ua: Те, з чого зрізали твій скалок, і досі лежить там на стелажі. І досі працює. Його ніхто не вимкнув — просто перестали записувати.

lines.en-us: That's all of it. If you're going, go before somebody reads my resignation. After that the shaft gets a new lock and I can't help you.
lines.ua-ua: Це все, що маю. Якщо підеш — іди, доки хтось не прочитав мою заяву. Після цього на шахті зміниться замок, і я вже не допоможу.

lines.en-us: Don't call back. There won't be anyone here.
lines.ua-ua: Не передзвонюй. Тут уже нікого не буде.
